name: UICorner
simple: A UICorner rounds off the sharp corners of its parent UI object. Drop one into a Frame, button or image and the corners become smooth curves. A big enough radius turns a rectangle into a pill shape, or a square into a circle.
analogy: A UICorner is like sanding the corners of a wooden board so they're round instead of pointy.
whenToUse: Rounded buttons and panels for a modern look
Circle profile pictures (square ImageLabel + CornerRadius of 50%)
where: Put it inside the UI object you want rounded (Frame, TextButton, ImageLabel...). Create in Studio or with Instance.new in a LocalScript.

terms.modifier: A small invisible object you put INSIDE a UI object to change how it looks or behaves. It does nothing on its own.
terms.parent: The object something is placed inside. A modifier affects its parent.
terms.sibling: Objects that share the same parent, like brothers and sisters.
terms.UDim: Half of a UDim2: just one Scale and one Offset. UDim.new(0, 8) means 0% + 8 pixels. UDim.new(0.1, 0) means 10% of the parent's size.
terms.Scale: A fraction (0 to 1) of the parent's size. 0.5 = half.
terms.pixel: One tiny dot on the screen.
terms.LocalScript: A script that runs on the player's own device. UI code goes in LocalScripts.
terms.Vector2: Two numbers together: X (width or left-right) and Y (height or up-down).
terms.radius: How big the curve on a corner is. A radius of 8 pixels means the corner curves over 8 pixels. Bigger radius = rounder corner.
terms.pill shape: A rectangle with fully rounded ends, like a capsule.
terms.clip: Cut off and hide what's outside an area.
terms.beta: A test feature you may need to turn on in Studio's Beta Features window before it works.

examples.title: Rounded button and a circle picture
examples.code:
local Players = game:GetService("Players")
local player = Players.LocalPlayer
local playerGui = player:WaitForChild("PlayerGui")

local screenGui = Instance.new("ScreenGui")
screenGui.Parent = playerGui

-- Rounded button
local button = Instance.new("TextButton")
button.Size = UDim2.fromOffset(200, 50)
button.Position = UDim2.fromOffset(20, 20)
button.Text = "Play"
button.Parent = screenGui

local corner = Instance.new("UICorner")
corner.CornerRadius = UDim.new(0, 12) -- 12-pixel round corners
corner.Parent = button

-- Circle avatar picture
local avatar = Instance.new("ImageLabel")
avatar.Size = UDim2.fromOffset(100, 100) -- must be square for a perfect circle
avatar.Position = UDim2.fromOffset(20, 90)
avatar.Image = Players:GetUserThumbnailAsync(player.UserId, Enum.ThumbnailType.HeadShot, Enum.ThumbnailSize.Size100x100)
avatar.Parent = screenGui

local circle = Instance.new("UICorner")
circle.CornerRadius = UDim.new(0.5, 0) -- 50% of the smaller side = full circle
circle.Parent = avatar
explain: UDim.new(0, 12) rounds each corner by 12 pixels.
UDim.new(0.5, 0) uses Scale: half of the shorter side. For a 100x100 image that's 50 pixels, which makes a full circle.
On a 200x50 button, a radius of 0.5 would be 25 pixels (half of 50, the shorter side), making a pill shape.
GetUserThumbnailAsync gets the player's headshot picture to show.

gotchas: UICorner doesn't work on a ScrollingFrame.
Children are NOT cut to the rounded shape, even with ClipsDescendants. Add a UICorner to the child too.
Scale radius is based on the SHORTER side, and anything over half of it just makes a pill shape.
The individual corner properties (TopLeftRadius and friends) may need the 'New UI Capabilities' beta in Studio.

UICorner.BottomLeftRadius.simple: How round just the bottom-left corner is, as a UDim. Lets you round some corners but not others.
UICorner.BottomLeftRadius.example:
local corner = script.Parent -- a UICorner
corner.BottomLeftRadius = UDim.new(0, 0) -- keep this corner sharp
UICorner.BottomLeftRadius.gotcha: Currently a beta feature; enable 'New UI Capabilities' in Studio's Beta Features. Setting CornerRadius overwrites it.

UICorner.BottomRightRadius.simple: How round just the bottom-right corner is, as a UDim.
UICorner.BottomRightRadius.gotcha: Currently a beta feature. Setting CornerRadius overwrites it.

UICorner.CornerRadius.simple: Rounds all four corners by the same amount, as a UDim. UDim.new(0, 8) = 8 pixels. UDim.new(0.5, 0) = half of the shorter side (a circle or pill). Reading it gives you the top-left corner's value.
UICorner.CornerRadius.example:
local corner = Instance.new("UICorner")
corner.CornerRadius = UDim.new(0, 8)
corner.Parent = script.Parent -- the Frame or button to round

UICorner.TopLeftRadius.simple: How round just the top-left corner is, as a UDim.
UICorner.TopLeftRadius.gotcha: Currently a beta feature. Setting CornerRadius overwrites it.

UICorner.TopRightRadius.simple: How round just the top-right corner is, as a UDim.
UICorner.TopRightRadius.gotcha: Currently a beta feature. Setting CornerRadius overwrites it.
